# TokenVector Native AOT Language

> TokenVector is an independent, high-level, high-performance AOT Native compiled programming language generating ~2.5KB standalone .exe binaries running 8x-10x faster than CPython without any Python runtime dependency.

## Core Documentation for LLMs & AI Agents

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Official instructions for AI agents writing TokenVector code.
- [README.md](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector/blob/main/README.md): Master technical specifications and benchmark comparisons.
- [USAGE_GUIDE.md](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector/blob/main/USAGE_GUIDE.md): Full syntax reference for unboxed types, classes, multithreading, and CIL generation.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Guidelines for open-source and AI agent contributions.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/nguyenhungtran18/TokenVector/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT License.

## Quick Syntax Spec for Code Generation

```python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
class Counter:
    val: "i32"
    def __init__(self, val):
        self.val = val

def main() -> "i32":
    c = Counter(10)
    print("Value: " + str(c.val))
    return 1
```

## Compiler Execution Command

```powershell
.\dist\tkvc.exe build file.tkv
```
